# SDS Design Tokens

Core design tokens for the Sapien Design System. Always use these values — never use Tailwind defaults for color, radius, shadow, or typography.

---

## Colors

### Brand Palette
```
brand-10:  #F5FAFF   — page background
brand-20:  #F0F8FF
brand-50:  #E6F3FF   — selected backgrounds, hover tints
brand-100: #CCE6FF
brand-500: #0183FF   — primary blue: links, active states, focus rings
brand-600: #0169CC   — hover on blue elements
brand-700: #014F99
```

### Neutrals
These are NOT Tailwind defaults — use these exact hex values:
```
#131313  — primary text, headings
#292929  — button hover (primary)
#4d4d4d  — secondary text, icons
#aaaaaa  — placeholder, disabled text
#e0e0e0  — borders, dividers
#f5f5f5  — hover backgrounds, disabled surfaces
white    — card/surface backgrounds
```

### Semantic Colors
```
success:     #1a7f4b  (green)
warning:     #b45309  (amber)  /  bg: #fef9e6
error:       #d32f2f  (red)    /  bg: #fde8e8
info:        #0183FF  (blue)   /  bg: #E6F3FF
purple:      #7c3aed            /  bg: #f3e8ff
teal:        #0e7490            /  bg: #e6f7f7
pink:        #be185d            /  bg: #fce8f3
```

---

## Typography

**Font family:** `font-darwin` (Darwin Sans) — always. Never use system font stacks or `font-sans`.

### Darwin Sans — Embedding in HTML / React Artifacts

Darwin Sans is a proprietary font. **Always embed it as inline base64 `@font-face` declarations.** Never link Google Fonts or any external URL.

#### The @font-face block (copy this into every artifact `<style>` or React `<style>` tag)

```css
/* ── DARWIN SANS — embedded @font-face (300 / 400 / 500 / 700 / 800) ── */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Darwin Sans';
  font-weight: 300;
  font-style: normal;
  src: url('data:font/otf;base64,') format('opentype');
}
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Darwin Sans';
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: normal;
  src: url('data:font/otf;base64,') format('opentype');
}
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Darwin Sans';
  font-weight: 500;
  font-style: normal;
  src: url('data:font/otf;base64,') format('opentype');
}
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Darwin Sans';
  font-weight: 700;
  font-style: normal;
  src: url('data:font/otf;base64,') format('opentype');
}
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Darwin Sans';
  font-weight: 800;
  font-style: normal;
  src: url('data:font/otf;base64,') format('opentype');
}
```

#### Usage
```css
/* Set globally on body */
body { font-family: 'Darwin Sans', sans-serif; }
```

#### Weight map
```
font-weight: 300  → Light
font-weight: 400  → Book  (regular)
font-weight: 500  → Medium
font-weight: 700  → Bold
font-weight: 800  → Extra Bold
```

> In React artifacts, inject via a `<style>` JSX element or a `useEffect` that appends to `document.head`.

### Type Scale
| Class         | Size  | Line Height | Usage                       |
|---------------|-------|-------------|-----------------------------|
| `text-title-l`  | 40px | 48px        | Page headings               |
| `text-title-m`  | 32px | 40px        | Section headings            |
| `text-title-s`  | 24px | 32px        | Card/panel headings         |
| `text-title-xs` | 20px | 24px        | Sub-headings, modal titles  |
| `text-body-l`   | 16px | 20px        | Large body text             |
| `text-body-m`   | 14px | 18px        | Default body text           |
| `text-body-s`   | 12px | 16px        | Labels, captions, help text |

### Font Weights
```
font-light      — 300
font-book       — 400
font-medium     — 500
font-bold       — 700
font-extrabold  — 800
```

---

## Spacing

Use multiples of 4 only: `4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64px`

---

## Border Radius

Always use SDS radius tokens — **never** `rounded-lg`, `rounded-xl`, `rounded-2xl`, etc.

```
rounded-sds-2    rounded-sds-4    rounded-sds-6    rounded-sds-8
rounded-sds-12   rounded-sds-16   rounded-sds-24
```

### Radius Usage Guide
| Token            | Common use                          |
|------------------|-------------------------------------|
| `rounded-sds-2`  | Checkboxes, tight inline elements   |
| `rounded-sds-4`  | Inputs, buttons, context menus      |
| `rounded-sds-6`  | —                                   |
| `rounded-sds-8`  | Cards (sm), modals, toasts          |
| `rounded-sds-12` | Cards (md)                          |
| `rounded-sds-16` | Cards (lg)                          |
| `rounded-sds-24` | Pills, badges, tab focus rings      |

---

## Shadows

Never use `shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`, `shadow-lg`.

```
shadow-sds-1        — subtle lift: buttons, small cards
shadow-sds-2        — medium depth: modals, floating cards
shadow-sds-3        — strong depth: overlays
shadow-sds-dropdown — dropdown menus
```

---

## Breakpoints

```
sm:  320px
md:  721px
lg:  1025px
xl:  1441px
```

---

## Animation

`animate-fadeSlideIn` — enter animation: 0.2s ease-out, slides down 8px from top.

Used on: Toasts, dropdowns, and other appearing elements.
